lead: Your named manager coordinates our remote team throughout your investment, with answers during local business hours and agreements built around your interests.

blocks.heading: Turnkey Management Across the Whole Investment Cycle
paragraphs: We manage your hotel turnkey across the whole investment cycle. You get a named manager who answers during your local business hours. After hours, your on-site team deals with operational issues. We structure our master service agreements to work in your favor as the owner.

blocks.heading: Staffing Support and the Owners We Serve

items.heading: Property staffing
items.text: We take care of [recruiting, staffing and training](/human-resources/) for your property and support the team that delivers your guest experience.

items.heading: Owners we serve
items.text: We [serve independent lodging owners](/about-us/) in countries including the United States, France, Canada and Australia. Our owners run hotels, motels, hostels, B&Bs, serviced apartments and short-term rentals.

blocks.heading: Acquisition, Development and Investment Advisory

items.heading: Planning before commitment
paragraphs: We prepare your asset and development plan before you sign. We test brand choice, diligence findings and financing together while the deal terms are still negotiable.

items.heading: Development support
paragraphs: We use our brand and network relationships to support diligence, transactions and sourcing. We stay with you through financing and development, and we have helped partners raise financing and equity.

items.heading: Investment trade-offs
paragraphs: Lenders and equity partners look for credible, brand-backed plans. Gaps are cheapest to fix during early diligence, but that diligence costs time and money. It also delivers less once you have committed to a brand and financing.

items.heading: Separate advisory mandate
paragraphs: Our [data-led acquisition advisory](/business-development/) sources and underwrites hotels separately from our management service. Fees are retainers set for each mandate, success fees paid at closing, or both, and we confirm them before work begins. After that, the choice of operator is yours.

blocks.heading: Transition, Pre-Opening and Licensing Support
paragraphs: Before handover or opening, we review your systems, staffing, contracts and permits, and we handle the licenses your hotel needs. Fixing gaps before guests arrive is cheaper and faster, but it takes your time and access to your data. If the handover window is short, we complete less of this work.

Our [management and pre-opening services](/) need 6 to 8 weeks before handover or 3 to 6 months before opening, and we also give advice earlier, at the design stage. You choose either a fixed monthly fee based on your room count or a percentage fee of 3% to 5% of total hotel revenue. On the percentage fee, full management that includes revenue and OTA management is at the upper end of that range, and properties with more than 100 rooms are toward the lower end. The agreed percentage changes only when your services change.

blocks.heading: Brand and Franchisor Relations That Work for Owners
paragraphs: We're your single point of contact with the brand, and we push back on standards and initiatives based on what they do to your property's returns. Renovations, system rollouts and program fees end up as your costs as the owner. Our relationships with brand councils give you a say before those requirements become mandatory. That influence doesn't override your franchise agreement, and it's weaker where our council involvement is lower.

With our [brand approval support](/asset-management/), we prepare the management-company submissions and join rebranding discussions alongside you. You authorize the franchise agreement, and we hold no approved or preferred franchisor status.

blocks.heading: Revenue Strategy and Dynamic Pricing
rows: Performance measures
We measure revenue management by gains in market share and profit per booking. Chasing occupancy or rate on its own loses value when channel costs and competitors are overlooked.
Engagement scope
We include revenue management in our hotel management or provide it on its own. When it's standalone, pricing decisions have less influence over sales, distribution and on-property operations.
Dedicated service and pricing

Our [revenue management service](/revenue-management/) gives you daily pricing decisions, weekly occupancy, ADR and RevPAR reports, and dashboard updates every 24 hours. Monthly Base / Extended / Complete prices are set by room band: up to 20 rooms, USD 750 / USD 1,040 / USD 1,300; 21–50 rooms, USD 1,090 / USD 1,500 / USD 1,900; 51–100 rooms, USD 1,600 / USD 2,200 / USD 2,800; 101–200 rooms, USD 2,300 / USD 3,100 / USD 4,000. One-time setup fees for those bands are USD 860, USD 1,400, USD 2,000 and USD 2,900 respectively.

blocks.heading: OTA Distribution and Listing Content
paragraphs: We [refresh your Booking.com listing](/ota-optimization/), covering photos, title, description, policies and amenity tags, and your existing reviews stay as they are.

blocks.heading: Sales, Marketing and Digital Demand

items.heading: Coordinated direct demand
paragraphs: We align website development, paid search, photography and video with your guest segments and rate strategy. That makes each one more effective and steers demand toward bookings that cost less than commissionable channels.

items.heading: Standalone marketing
paragraphs: Marketing comes as part of full management or on its own. When it's standalone, results depend on your operating team delivering the guest experience and pricing that our campaigns promise.

items.heading: Commercial planning
paragraphs: Our [commercial strategy plans](/commercial-strategy/) bring direct sales, eCommerce, revenue management and digital marketing together for your property.

items.heading: Booking-level measurement
paragraphs: We [track campaign conversions](/digital-marketing/) through your booking engine. We report completed reservations, booking value, spend and acquisition cost by channel, rather than traffic alone.

blocks.heading: Capital Projects, Design and Construction Oversight
paragraphs: We negotiate each item in your property improvement plan with your brand and agree the scope, order and schedule. Then we bid out contractors and suppliers before work starts. Agreeing alternatives and phasing up front prevents expensive change orders and long room closures. The negotiation adds preparation time, and some brand standards can't be changed.

Our [turnkey capital project management](/project-management/) charges a fixed fee for oversight and remote review, and we agree that fee before work begins. Specialist design, engineering and inspections are charged at cost. We revise the fee only when the approved scope or schedule changes, and we agree any revision with you in writing.

blocks.heading: Procurement Backed by Group Buying Power

items.heading: Group buying power
paragraphs: We pool your purchasing through a group purchasing programme. Its national and regional programs get you better pricing and terms for hotels from economy to luxury.

items.heading: Purchasing categories
paragraphs: We source OS&E, F&B, hotel technology, equipment, facility services, energy management and other categories through negotiated programs.

items.heading: Controlled purchasing
paragraphs: We handle orders, approvals and payments on one procure-to-pay platform. We track spend by category in a single owner report, which keeps your purchasing compliant and shows you the savings.

items.heading: Specialist support
paragraphs: You get category expertise, an account manager, and compliance and risk management. We keep sustainability and ESG in view throughout procurement.

items.heading: Supplier constraints
paragraphs: Where your brand mandates suppliers or a local contract is binding, that requirement overrides program pricing in the affected categories. Switching vendors takes time.

blocks.heading: Performance Reporting, Forecasts and Budgets

items.heading: Forward planning
items.text: We forecast 12 months ahead under conservative, realistic and optimistic scenarios. That shows you the downside risk and how we respond when demand changes.

items.heading: Budget decisions
items.text: We build your budget on the realistic scenario. We use the other two cases to plan staffing, spending and pricing decisions in advance.

items.heading: Market evidence
items.text: We assess demand, seasonality and your competitors, then set seasonal pricing bands and expected occupancy. Forecasts are updated whenever market conditions and comparison data change.

items.heading: Accounting continuity
items.text: With our [standalone accounting service](/accounting/), we move your bookkeeping onto our platform and your accountant keeps full access to your documents. Each month we export your ledger to QuickBooks for year-end and tax work.

blocks.heading: Property Technology and Systems Integration

items.heading: Connected property systems
paragraphs: We connect your PMS, channel manager and guest messaging tools so that rates, inventory and guest data match. That cuts overbookings and rate errors and supports reliable business intelligence.

items.heading: Operational technology
paragraphs: Our IT services include concierge tools and supporting platforms. Moving to our preferred systems involves migration and retraining. Where your brand requires certain systems, changes to them are restricted.

items.heading: Compatibility and continuity
paragraphs: Our [systems integration and outage support](/information-technology/) needs remote access and daily exports. We replace incompatible systems, hold your OTA inventory during outages and supply offline front-desk records every night. We also escalate issues to vendors and re-sync reservations within 2 hours of systems being restored.

blocks.heading: Lender and Distressed Asset Support
paragraphs: We [support nonperforming hotel loans](/receivership/) through foreclosure, bankruptcy, workouts and receivership. In a receivership, the lender pays one flat fee that covers hotel operations and all receivership services, with no separate receiver fee and no recovery percentage. An out-of-court workout has a fixed diagnostic fee, a monthly retainer and an optional success fee tied to the recovery targets we agree. In both cases, third-party costs are billed to the property at cost.

hero.heading: Hotel Business Development, from Deal Sourcing to Opening Day
lead: Our deal sourcing connects you with hotel investments in US and Canadian markets where better operations, rebranding or renovation can add value.

cta.label: Talk to us about business development

blocks.heading: Business Development for Your Hotel Portfolio
paragraphs: We find on- and off-market hotel investment opportunities for you in the top US Metropolitan Statistical Areas and major Canadian markets. We look at where value can be added through better operations, rebranding or renovation, and we give you lead-generation sources that keep new deals and hotel business coming your way.

blocks.heading: Off-Market Deal Sourcing and Due Diligence

items.heading: Sourcing and screening
paragraphs: Our network of hospitality owners brings us off-market targets, and we look at listings as well. We screen the market and its position in the cycle first, then the operations, using supply, demand, occupancy, ADR and RevPAR projections and competitive-set rates. You only see assets that pass both screens.

items.heading: Remote document review
paragraphs: We go through the P&Ls, rate and booking history, franchise and management agreements, vendor contracts and PIP documents. We check operations through scheduled video walkthroughs.

items.heading: Independent site inspections
paragraphs: Property condition, engineering, environmental and code inspections need professionals on site. We commission an independent local inspector or engineer, or work with the one your team appoints. We go through their report with you within 5 business days.

items.heading: Acquisition diligence report
paragraphs: For every acquisition we assess, you get a report covering local market trends, historical earnings and realistic earnings potential. It also includes a financial model projecting future results.

items.heading: Obligations and competitive position
paragraphs: Your diligence report looks at the management contract, franchise affiliation, competitive position, property improvement plan obligations and capital expenditure requirements.

items.heading: Priced risks and decisions
paragraphs: Every red flag comes with an estimated cost to fix it and our recommendation to either negotiate a lower price or walk away. The report ends with the acquisition risks, the unresolved issues and the conditions you need to meet before going ahead.

items.heading: Pre-closing team review
paragraphs: Before you close, our operations and sales teams remotely assess current operations, staffing, rate strategy and channel mix. They also review vendor, franchise and management contracts and your PIP and capital exposure.

items.heading: Written asset review
paragraphs: Within 10 business days of getting access to the seller's operating reports and data room, we send you the asset review report, which sets out prioritised risks and upside opportunities.

blocks.heading: Who We Work With and How Mandates Work

items.heading: Who we support
paragraphs: We work with both first-time investors and portfolio owners, and acquisitions have no minimum deal size or room count.

items.heading: Mandate arrangements
paragraphs: Sourcing is non-exclusive by default. If you prefer, it can be exclusive for one market for 6 months. You choose the arrangement for your mandate.

items.heading: Competing client interests
paragraphs: When a deal suits several clients, we present it to them in the order they signed their mandates. We never advise two clients bidding on the same asset.

items.heading: Your starting documents
paragraphs: Send us your markets, room count, budget, target returns, proof of funds or a lender letter, your diligence team's contacts and a signed NDA. If you're a first-time investor, clear information lets us quickly find deals you can realistically close.

items.heading: Transaction experience
paragraphs: Since 2016, we've sourced, underwritten or supported 15 hotel acquisitions and sales involving independent hotels and motels of 20 to 250 rooms. Before you sign, you can ask for an anonymised transaction list showing property types, sizes and our roles.

blocks.heading: Underwriting and Investment Analysis

items.heading: Investment assessment
items.text: We look for upside in expanding your portfolio or repositioning. We underwrite each opportunity with market analysis, operating proformas and budgets.

items.heading: Downside-led decisions
items.text: We judge a deal by how well it holds up on the downside. Every model tests occupancy and ADR at 10% to 20% below the base case.

items.heading: Cost and financing stress
items.text: Every model also tests renovation costs 15% over budget, interest rates 200 basis points higher and exit cap rates 50 to 100 basis points wider.

items.heading: Return and coverage effects
items.text: For each downside case, you see its effect on IRR, cash-on-cash return and debt service coverage.

items.heading: Working underwriting package
items.text: Within 10 business days of receiving the offering materials and data, we deliver the complete underwriting, an Excel investment model with open formulas and a PDF investment summary.

items.heading: Your advisers involved
items.text: We work alongside your lender, broker and lawyers, and your team gets a working model to test its own assumptions.

items.heading: Under-contract and refinancing support
items.text: If a deal is already under contract, we take it on for underwriting and diligence only. We also support refinancing for hotels you already own.

items.heading: Focused assignment scope
items.text: These assignments cover market performance trends, historical and achievable operating results, forecasts, and reviews of existing management and franchise agreements.

blocks.heading: Debt and Equity Financing and Exit Strategy

items.heading: Debt and equity
paragraphs: We've helped investors raise both debt and equity. For acquisitions and development, the lenders we introduce you to include local and national banks, SBA lenders for US deals, CMBS, debt funds, bridge lenders and construction lenders. We don't lend money ourselves.

items.heading: Financing through closing
paragraphs: We put together your financing package and compare term sheets on total cost, covenants and flexibility, not just the headline rate. We support you through negotiations right up to closing, and our development support continues once you've chosen the hotel.

items.heading: Exit planning
paragraphs: We plan your exit at the same time as your financing. When you're ready to sell, we find buyers for the asset.

items.heading: Licensed partner delivery
paragraphs: We don't hold a real estate or mortgage broker licence. When placing debt or searching for buyers requires one, we direct licensed partner brokers in the relevant US state, Canadian province, France or Australia.

blocks.heading: Brand Selection, Franchise and Repositioning

items.heading: Brand selection
items.text: We judge each flag by its net effect on your results, weighing local demand against fees, PIP requirements and contract terms. Then we negotiate your franchise agreement.

items.heading: Product positioning
items.text: We set your hotel's positioning. When an existing property needs a new direction, we handle the repositioning and rebranding.

items.heading: Conversion timing
items.text: While your current franchise is still in force, we plan the conversion and negotiate the new agreement, and we time PIP delivery to match your exit date.

items.heading: Legal responsibilities
items.text: Your counsel handles termination notices, liquidated damages, settlements with the outgoing brand and the legal review of the new licence agreement.

items.heading: Counsel coordination
items.text: We give your legal team the brand timeline, PIP costs and rate data it needs for that work.

blocks.heading: Design Review and Property Improvement Plans
paragraphs: Before construction starts, we review the design and architecture, and we price and manage your property improvement plan. Your written review checks the layout, back-of-house areas, room mix, building systems and FF&E specifications against brand standards, operating flow and guest experience. Every finding comes with a priority, a recommended change, an estimated cost and its operating impact, so you deal with the most consequential issues before you build. You get the first report within 10 business days of us receiving the drawings, and we review revised sets within 5 business days.

blocks.heading: Pre-Construction Team and FF&E Procurement

items.heading: Project delivery and purchasing
paragraphs: Our [project management](/project-management/) covers FF&E procurement and oversight of delivery. You get monthly reports and weekly updates. Any forecast more than 5% over a budget line needs approval. We complete takeover reviews within 10 business days of receiving the project documents.

items.heading: Team and opening preparation
paragraphs: Our [hotel management support](/) coordinates the designers and consultants your project requires, franchisor and manager document checks, communication with the construction team, change-order and schedule decisions, and pre-opening budgets, procurement and marketing.

blocks.heading: Construction Oversight and Site Reporting
paragraphs: We don't attend the property, so daily site supervision is handled by your general contractor's site superintendent or the owner's representative you appoint. We need their detailed daily logs, photos and weekly video walkthroughs so we can review the work remotely, and we raise any issues with you within 3 business days.

blocks.heading: Pre-Opening Services and Launch

items.heading: Annual marketing plan
items.text: Before you open, we prepare your hotel's annual marketing plan, which sets the commercial plan for your launch.

items.heading: Budget and revenue execution
items.text: We prepare your operating budget before opening and put your revenue strategy into action from day one.

items.heading: Hotel staff recruitment
items.text: We recruit and hire your hotel's staff through our [human resources service](/human-resources/).

blocks.heading: Deal Services Priced per Mandate
paragraphs: We price sourcing, underwriting, debt sourcing and buyer search for each mandate, and we agree the fees with you in writing before any work begins. Fees are set by the size and complexity of your brief. Fixed work is on a retainer, work with uncertain results has a larger success component, and some briefs use a mix of the two. Success fees are paid when the deal completes.

blocks.heading: Fixed Fees for Development Work
paragraphs: Before you sign, we quote [development work](/development/) based on its scope. The quote is either a fixed project fee or a monthly retainer for the months the work runs, and it's never a percentage of your pre-opening or FF&E budgets. Suppliers contract directly with your ownership entity at their own prices, so there's no resale and no mark-up, and we earn nothing from what you spend.

hero.heading: Hotel Digital Marketing That Drives Direct Bookings
lead: More guests can book straight with you when we connect your rate visibility, booking website and reputation across major travel search platforms.

cta.label: Talk to us about digital marketing

blocks.heading: Digital marketing that brings rate shoppers to your own website
paragraphs: When guests decide where to click, your own booking link is up against OTA offers. We build your hotel's digital marketing presence on Google, trivago, TripAdvisor and Kayak. We link rate visibility, your booking website and your guest reputation so bookings come straight to you.

blocks.heading: Free booking links, Hotel Ads and a live rate feed

items.heading: Free links first
paragraphs: Before we recommend any paid advertising, we connect and verify your feed. Google's free booking links show your direct rate at no charge, and they start appearing a few days after verification.

items.heading: Paid campaign readiness
paragraphs: Free links let us check how accurate and competitive your feed is without spending anything. Paid clicks are only worth buying once your feed is accurate and your rate matches or beats the OTAs.

items.heading: Google paid campaigns
paragraphs: We maintain your metasearch listings. We run paid placements only on Google Hotel Ads, not on trivago, TripAdvisor or Kayak.

items.heading: Live rate connection
paragraphs: Your booking engine or channel manager has to supply live rates and availability. We connect that feed or check the connection you already have.

items.heading: Incompatible booking engines
paragraphs: If your engine can't send live rates, we talk with you about routing through a channel manager or switching to a compatible engine before any extra costs come up. You don't need to rebuild your website.

items.heading: Connectivity charges
paragraphs: On top of your advertising spend, your provider's feed or connectivity charges are billed to your property at cost, with no mark-up from us.

items.heading: Agency handover
paragraphs: We take over your existing campaigns through a structured transfer of your accounts, listings, advertising accounts, creative assets and performance data.

items.heading: Independent hotel management
paragraphs: MotelPilot provides [third-party hotel management](/) for independent hotels. We run your day-to-day operations remotely, and you keep ownership of your property.

blocks.heading: A Google Business Profile built for hotel search filters

items.heading: Ownership first
items.text: We fix any control problems before we start on the profile. If your hotel doesn't control the account, you lose any improvements made on it.

items.heading: Transfers and reinstatement
items.text: We request ownership through Google, merge or remove duplicate listings, and appeal suspensions with the required business documents. That way, verification sits under your own Google account.

items.heading: Complete hotel details
items.text: We fill in your rooms, amenities, categories, descriptions, and accessibility and sustainability attributes. Missing information keeps a property out of the relevant hotel filters and rankings.

items.heading: One coordinated pass
items.text: We handle content, settings, visuals and trust signals together. That covers every ranking signal Google Hotel Ads uses, instead of fixing fields one at a time.

items.heading: Photos and activity
items.text: We put your profile photos in a deliberate order, caption every image, and set up questions, answers and profile posts.

items.heading: English and French
items.text: We write your listings and review replies in English or French. If your hotel is in France or Quebec, you get French content and replies.

blocks.heading: A direct rate that stays accurate, competitive and in parity

items.heading: Competitive direct rates
paragraphs: We correct your direct rate before you spend anything on metasearch. Then we check OTA parity after setup and again at your 30-day review.

items.heading: Value beyond parity
paragraphs: If your rate only matches the OTAs or loses to them, a paid click is wasted. So we recommend member rates or perks that give guests better value while staying within your OTA contracts.

items.heading: Revenue issue resolution
paragraphs: Through [revenue management](/revenue-management/), we alert you to unusual booking pace, ranking drops and parity breaks, and we make the fixes ourselves.

blocks.heading: From the metasearch click to a tracked direct booking

items.heading: Landing page repairs
paragraphs: Before we judge performance, we fix your metasearch landing page so it shows clear rates, direct booking incentives and trust signals.

items.heading: Booking flow checks
paragraphs: We audit every step up to reservation confirmation and test bookings on mobile. Where a change has to be made inside your booking-engine supplier's system, we give your supplier the exact settings changes in writing.

items.heading: Consent before tracking
paragraphs: Conversion tracking starts only after a visitor gives consent. We use a consent banner and Google's consent mode, in line with the GDPR.

items.heading: French data hosting
paragraphs: If your property is in France and you ask for this arrangement, we keep the related tracking data on EU servers.

items.heading: Booking attribution window
paragraphs: We count a booking-engine reservation when it's completed within 30 days of a click from Google Hotel Ads, free booking links, trivago, TripAdvisor or Kayak.

items.heading: Verified booking totals
paragraphs: We deduplicate by reservation number, reconcile the totals with your PMS every month, and take out cancelled and refunded reservations. That way, each qualifying booking counts once.

blocks.heading: Guest reviews and ratings across every channel

items.heading: Reputation baseline
items.text: We audit your existing reputation, set your response strategy and monitor your ratings across every channel.

items.heading: Every departing guest
items.text: Through a regular feedback collection routine, we invite every departing guest to review their stay.

items.heading: Automated review requests
items.text: If your messaging tool or PMS supports scheduled messages, we use it to send review invitations automatically.

items.heading: Front desk fallback
items.text: If your system can't schedule invitations, we give you a review-request email and link, and your front desk sends it at check-out.

items.heading: Routine review replies
items.text: We draft your Google and TripAdvisor replies from templates and email each one to you for approval. When changes are needed, we revise them with you.

items.heading: Publication under your control
items.text: We publish on the day you approve. Nothing goes live automatically or without your sign-off.

items.heading: Serious complaint escalation
items.text: When a complaint involves safety, hygiene or billing, we flag it to your property contact within 1 business day. We also ask your on-site team for the stay details, what happened and what action was taken.

items.heading: Personal complaint responses
items.text: We never use templates for serious complaints. With your approval, we publish a personal reply within 2 business days of receiving the facts.

blocks.heading: Booking.com, Expedia and other OTA listings kept consistent

items.heading: Shoots tied to changes
paragraphs: We organise photography when your property opens, renovates, launches a marketing campaign or refreshes its website, not as an unrelated exercise.

items.heading: Photographer coordination
paragraphs: We run the shoot from start to finish. We write the shot list, negotiate with photographers and brief them.

items.heading: Consistent image sets
paragraphs: We upload the same on-brand images to your website and your OTA listings, and we follow your brand-specific guidelines on every platform.

items.heading: Outsourced OTA management
paragraphs: Our [OTA management](/ota-optimization/) includes Booking.com optimisation in 2 to 3 business days, daily availability checks, extranet closures within 2 hours of any discrepancy, and same-day overbooking alerts. You can take it alongside revenue management, either on its own or together with hotel management.

blocks.heading: Sales, marketing and reputation working as one
paragraphs: We bring direct sales, revenue management and multichannel digital advertising together in one plan, with consistent messaging and data-led content. Our teams agree packages based on your hotel's needs and the guests you're targeting. Website development, SEO, online marketing, social media and CRM support that work, alongside our dedicated sales and revenue-generation platform.

In our [commercial strategy](/commercial-strategy/), our own sales-trained team works across markets. It combines sales activity data, targeted e-commerce and cross-selling to bring in direct group, corporate and leisure bookings, and we don't outsource the marketing.

blocks.heading: From your first enquiry to your first direct bookings

steps.heading: Send your details
steps.text: Send us your website, Google listing and booking engine or channel manager. We review your existing feeds and compare your direct and OTA rates that same day.

steps.heading: Model and audit
steps.text: Before you commit, we use your own figures to model the net effect. We also audit your rate accuracy, your parity, your Google, TripAdvisor and trivago profiles, and your landing page.

steps.heading: Resolve and launch
steps.text: We fix everything the audit finds before we connect and configure your live implementation, so you don't launch with known gaps.

steps.heading: Review early results
steps.text: Direct metasearch bookings appear within the first month. At your 30-day check-in, we review your visibility, traffic, bookings and the commission you've avoided.

steps.heading: Report net returns
steps.text: Your report shows your direct booking revenue after cancellations, advertising costs and booking-engine or payment fees, alongside the OTA commission you've avoided. It doesn't show gross bookings alone.

blocks.heading: Monthly bids, feed checks and reporting after day 30

items.heading: Project or monthly engagement
items.text: Your initial setup is a one-time project. After day 30, monthly support keeps your bids and feeds checked when your rates and availability change frequently.

items.heading: Weekly bid adjustments
items.text: If you keep us on monthly, we adjust your metasearch bids every week as part of that ongoing engagement.

items.heading: Daily feed checks
items.text: During monthly support, we check your live rate feed every day for errors in prices or availability.

items.heading: Monthly profile updates
items.text: Throughout the ongoing engagement, we refresh your Google Business Profile photos, posts and offers every month.

items.heading: Reports by channel
items.text: By the 5th business day of each month, we send you PDF and spreadsheet reports covering impressions, clicks, direct bookings, cost per booking and commission saved.

items.heading: Access and strategy calls
items.text: You can see the same figures anytime on our reporting platform, and we go through them together on your monthly strategy call.

items.heading: Alongside your existing agency
items.text: You can hire us for metasearch and reputation while your agency keeps your website, SEO and other advertising. Our scope includes review replies, attribution and the check-in.

blocks.heading: Setup fees, monthly fees and an ad spend that stays yours

items.heading: Budget without a minimum
items.text: Paid Hotel Ads have no fixed minimum. We size your budget to your markets and booking goals, and we recommend a campaign only when the expected bookings justify the spend.

items.heading: Campaign management model
items.text: We build the campaign structure and manage your bids and budgets on either a commission-per-stay or a CPC model, whichever suits your margins.

items.heading: Fees by room band
items.text: Setup and monthly fees are charged per property, in bands of up to 20, 21–50, 51–100 and 101–200 rooms. The same bands apply to metasearch-and-reputation-only engagements.

items.heading: Included metasearch channels
items.text: Both fees cover up to 4 metasearch channels: Google, trivago, TripAdvisor and Kayak.

items.heading: Additional monthly charges
items.text: Each extra channel, and any paid Hotel Ads campaign we manage, adds to your monthly service fee.

items.heading: Advertising spend stays yours
items.text: Your advertising accounts stay in your name. Your spend is paid from your Google account, separately from our fee, and it never passes through us.

items.heading: Standalone digital services
items.text: You can buy website development, SEO and paid search on their own, without putting your hotel under our management.

items.heading: Website and search billing
items.text: A new website has a fixed project fee. Ongoing search and paid campaigns are billed monthly after the three-month initial period.

blocks.heading: Hospitality Human Resources Built Around Your Leadership
paragraphs: Pay scales, yearly wage rises, bonuses and dismissals stay under your final control. Our hotel HR team works directly with your senior leadership on people strategy and performance management.

Inside the budget you approve, we set your employees' hourly rates and propose any disciplinary measures. Any salary or senior appointment outside that budget needs your approval before it goes ahead. Nobody is terminated until you or the manager you nominate signs off.

blocks.heading: Getting Started: Property Review & Handover
paragraphs: The handover, the property review and our staffing recommendations set the priorities for your people function. Once we receive your complete set of documents, your people function is fully running within 30 days.

visuals.purpose: Explain why complete documents come first and how the review leads to staffing recommendations.

items.label: Complete document handover
items.detail: Send your organisation chart, employee files and contracts, the last 12 months of payroll registers, handbook and policies, open vacancies and any collective agreement in one batch. Partial setup does not start on incomplete files.

items.label: Detailed property review

items.label: Staffing priorities and recommendations

blocks.heading: Who We Are & Which Properties Qualify

items.heading: Our company
paragraphs: We provide HR services either on their own or as part of full management.

items.heading: Any property size
paragraphs: There's no minimum headcount for you to qualify. A 20-room motel with five staff is eligible for our HR service.

items.heading: Small-team scope
paragraphs: For a small property like yours, we concentrate on recruitment, onboarding, payroll and employment compliance, and we leave out programmes designed only for larger hotels.

items.heading: Our wider team
paragraphs: [Our team](/about-us/) is 25 people working across hotel operations, revenue management and owner reporting, and they all support your property.

blocks.heading: Remote Hiring With On-Site Support
paragraphs: We recruit, place and onboard your candidates remotely, and we interview them by video. Your ownership entity stays the legal employer. We draft the offer letters and employment contracts for you to sign, and we send them out with the onboarding forms for electronic signature.

You choose a named general manager, on-site manager or local contact. That person checks original identity and right-to-work documents in person and runs any in-person final interviews or trials you ask for. On day one, they also hand out uniforms and keys and give a tour of the property. We handle every other step remotely.

blocks.heading: Your Named HR Contact, Ready to Help
paragraphs: You get one named HR contact for your hotel, not a shared ticket queue. Your managers phone or email that person directly with day-to-day HR questions, and they get an answer within one business day.

blocks.heading: Recruitment & Team Building

items.heading: Hiring decisions and timing
paragraphs: Before we start searching, we agree your budget and how you want sign-off to work. Within that budget, we hire with your general manager, unless you want to approve hires yourself. Once the search starts, hourly roles take 14 to 21 days and management roles take 30 to 45 days.

items.heading: Candidate and contract fit
paragraphs: We screen candidates for the skills each role needs and for a personality that suits your hotel. We recruit hourly, salaried and tipped employees on full-time, part-time, seasonal and temporary terms.

items.heading: Departments and seasonal preparation
paragraphs: We recruit across front desk, housekeeping, maintenance, food and beverage, and management. If your property is seasonal, we start 8 weeks before opening, so your team is ready on day one.

items.heading: Training and development
paragraphs: Your front-desk team completes six structured remote video sessions within the first 30 days of working with us. We also develop and support staff retention, deliver leadership development, and provide sales and marketing training and direction.

items.heading: Replacement recruitment
paragraphs: If someone we recruited resigns or is dismissed for performance within their first 90 days, we find you a replacement with no additional recruitment fee.

items.heading: Required pre-start checks
paragraphs: Before anyone starts, we check at least two employment references, the required licences and certificates (including food-handling or first-aid credentials), and their right to work under your country’s rules. All of these checks are finished within 5 business days of the offer.

items.heading: Conditional background screening
paragraphs: Where local law permits it and your candidate consents, we arrange background checks through licensed local screening providers, and your property is billed at cost.

items.heading: Full hotel management
paragraphs: With [third-party management](/), we run an independent hotel’s daily operations remotely while you keep ownership. We recruit, onboard, orient and train your General Manager and Director of Sales, including brand immersion when it’s required.

blocks.heading: Full Range of HR Functions, Options & Pricing

items.heading: People programmes
items.text: Our HR lead oversees organisational design, compensation and benefits, talent acquisition and retention, cultural immersion, onboarding, training, change management, safety, risk control, and employee and labour relations.

items.heading: HR administration
items.text: We administer your payroll, benefits, policies, procedures and compliance, manage your HR technology and reporting, and provide consulting for your hotel.

items.heading: Scope you choose
items.text: You buy only the modules you need. Full HR planning, executive search, recruitment, payroll, and consulting and policy projects are each available on their own. Ongoing leadership of your property team requires full management.

items.heading: Existing employment arrangements
items.text: We take on your current staff, contracts, handbook and policies as they stand, and we propose changes only after we’ve reviewed them with you.

items.heading: Unionised properties
items.text: We keep the wage, scheduling and grievance terms of your existing collective agreement, and we hold our first video meeting with union representatives within 7 days of starting.

items.heading: Management fee coverage
items.text: Under full management, your management fee covers staff leadership, recruitment and payroll processing for your team.

items.heading: Standalone service charges
items.text: For standalone recruitment, you pay per hire; for HR consulting or policy work, you pay a fixed project fee.

items.heading: Your advance quote
items.text: We give you a quote before you sign, based on your headcount, the number of hires you expect each year, the modules you select and how many properties you have.

blocks.heading: Staffing, Payroll, Reporting & Incident Response

items.heading: Staffing and shift schedules
paragraphs: We prepare departmental staffing tables, schedules, screening steps, and hiring and training guidelines, and we adjust staffing every week to match forecast occupancy. Your on-site manager publishes the rota and handles same-day swaps.

items.heading: Your system choice
paragraphs: We set up one cloud HR and payroll system for your payroll and employee records. If your existing HRIS, payroll provider and time-tracking system give us remote user access, we keep them instead.

items.heading: Monthly owner reporting
paragraphs: Each month, your owner reporting pack covers headcount, turnover, labour cost against budget, open positions, training completion and the incident log.

items.heading: Quarterly workforce review
paragraphs: Every quarter, we add a workforce review that sets out trends and our staffing recommendations for your property.

items.heading: Immediate on-site response
paragraphs: We don’t have any staff at your property. Your on-site manager or local contact handles immediate safety and calls emergency services first, then contacts our on-call HR line.

items.heading: Round-the-clock HR response
paragraphs: Our on-call line runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and we respond within 2 hours to workplace injuries, harassment complaints, no-shows and sudden resignations.

items.heading: Incident records and investigation
paragraphs: We guide your incident records and your insurance or workers’ compensation filings, start harassment investigations within one business day, and help your team arrange shift cover remotely.

items.heading: Payroll across roles
paragraphs: Our [payroll service](/accounting/) covers tipped, hourly and salaried employees, distributes service charges, and pays staff who work across departments at the correct rate for each role.

blocks.heading: Labor Law Compliance

items.heading: Pre-takeover compliance review
items.text: Before we take over, we go through your contracts, handbook, pay, overtime, timekeeping and required workplace notices to find any compliance gaps.

items.heading: Written findings and fixes
items.text: Within 15 business days of receiving your documents, you get our written findings with prioritised fixes, and we deal with the most serious gaps first.

items.heading: Employment law monitoring
items.text: We keep track of employment law changes in your jurisdiction, including minimum wage increases, health care rules and overtime requirements.

items.heading: Updates before implementation
items.text: When the law changes, we update the affected policies, pay rates and processes before the change takes effect, and we list every update in your monthly report.

items.heading: Local jurisdiction coverage
items.text: We cover US states, Canadian provinces, France, Australia and the other countries where we work with owners. We check your policies against the rules in your jurisdiction and confirm the requirements with local employment counsel.

items.heading: Accountable legal review
items.text: Our HR lead oversees every compliance check, and counsel licensed in your country, state or province reviews each new policy before it goes live.

cta.label: Talk to us about operations management

blocks.heading: Remote Operations Management Built Around Your Hotel
paragraphs: We build a business plan specific to your hotel and carry it out, so your profitability and investment performance improve. Our operations management works as an extension of your ownership team and gives you, as a hotel or resort owner, hands-on professional support.

blocks.heading: Ownership-Aligned Business Plans and Hands-On Oversight

items.heading: Ownership-led planning
paragraphs: Your return targets drive our budget, staffing and capital decisions, not last year's budget. If a target is unrealistic for your market, we flag it during planning because it requires early reforecasting.

items.heading: Whole-property coverage
paragraphs: We manage your property remotely. That covers budgets, pricing, staffing, costs, contracts and reporting. We have no staff on site, so your teams deliver the on-site services.

items.heading: Local management contact
paragraphs: If you don't have a resident GM, we handle planning, pricing, budgets, vendors and staff leadership through the on-site lead you nominate. If your property has more than 50 rooms or has food and beverage outlets, we recommend an on-site duty manager on every shift.

items.heading: Existing agreement restrictions
paragraphs: We keep your SOPs and brand standards, support your department heads and follow your franchise, loan, lease and supply restrictions. Our onboarding review identifies any savings or changes those terms block, and you decide whether to keep or renegotiate those terms.

items.heading: Your business plan
paragraphs: Your plan includes a 12-month budget, a staffing model, revenue, GOP and NOI targets and a 5-year capital plan. We base it on the last 24 months of your P&L and bookings, on market and competitive-set data and on your return targets.

items.heading: Delivery and review
paragraphs: We deliver your plan within 20 business days of receiving your data and read-only system access. We review actual results with you on monthly strategy calls. When results diverge from the plan, we update forecasts quarterly, and we rebuild the plan every year.

items.heading: Evidence before signing
paragraphs: Before you sign, our [case studies and owner references](/case-studies/) give you calls with up to 3 current clients who have consented to speak with you. You also get anonymised RevPAR, occupancy and NOI comparisons covering the 12 months before and the 12 months after we took over.

blocks.heading: Group Purchasing Power and Supplier Savings
paragraphs: Our purchasing programmes turn our combined buying volume into supplier savings for your property. They cover the United States, Canada, France and Australia, and they also cover clients who take only revenue management or OTA management.

Before you switch, you compare our negotiated prices with your current contracts item by item and move only the categories where the savings are clear. Categories restricted by franchise-approved lists or exclusive local contracts are excluded. Suppliers outside the countries we cover are also excluded.

blocks.heading: How Remote Third-Party Operations Work for Your Property

items.heading: Remote daily oversight
paragraphs: We direct guest service and finances through shared systems, reporting and scheduled calls, and your staff carry out the decisions on site. You get consistent standards and financial control without a resident management team.

items.heading: Operational fit
paragraphs: Remote management requires a reliable on-site contact and up-to-date systems. It works best for properties that don't have complex daily on-site operations.

items.heading: Management agreement terms
paragraphs: Under [hotel management](/), you keep ownership and pay either 3% to 5% of revenue or a fixed fee based on your room count. You can also choose to add 10% of GOP above budget. If we miss the RevPAR-index or GOP targets for 2 consecutive quarters, you can exit without a fee on 30 days’ notice.

items.heading: Independent asset oversight
paragraphs: Our [asset management](/asset-management/) oversees your operations, renovations and operators using read-only PMS and accounting access, weekly operator reports and scheduled video walkthroughs. When needed, we commission independent local inspections, and we review the reports with you within 5 business days.

blocks.heading: Your Accounts and How You Can Leave

items.heading: Owner-held accounts
items.text: From day one, every login, account and data record is in your ownership entity's name, so you can leave without needing our consent.

items.heading: Administrative responsibility
items.text: Because you hold the accounts, you handle administrative tasks that a manager would otherwise handle, such as vendor billing contacts and access renewals.

items.heading: Orderly handover
items.text: When our agreement ends, we return your booking, guest and financial records, logins and accounts intact. Your operations keep running while everything transfers to you or your next operator.

blocks.heading: Staffing, Recruitment and Payroll Support

items.heading: Recruitment and development
paragraphs: Our [human resources support](/human-resources/) covers hiring, training and keeping your hotel's staff.

items.heading: Payroll records and corrections
paragraphs: For [payroll processing](/accounting/), you submit department-approved time records and tip, service-charge or pay-rate changes by noon on the second business day after each pay period. We pay undisputed hours on schedule and flag gaps. We correct missing or disputed records in the next run.

blocks.heading: On-Demand Operational Services With No Long-Term Contract

items.heading: Start with defined work
paragraphs: If you're unsure about full management, you can start with a fixed-scope revenue audit, pricing and distribution strategy and team training. These show you our work and its value before you make any ongoing commitment. Any operational help after that addresses the gaps they identify.

items.heading: Limits between engagements
paragraphs: On-demand help gives you no continuous oversight. Between engagements, problems that need steady daily management come back if nobody manages them.

items.heading: Standalone service choices
paragraphs: Our [standalone services](/capabilities/) cover operations, sales and marketing, procurement, accounting, OTA management, websites, paid search and asset management, and you need no management agreement or long-term contract. Only ongoing leadership of your hotel staff requires full management.

blocks.heading: Pre-Opening Readiness, Licences and Insurance
paragraphs: Your ownership entity holds the operating licences, permits, property insurance and general liability insurance. We track renewals and prepare the paperwork 60 days before anything expires. You sign, pay, and supply the documents and inspections that only an owner can provide. Because you hold the licences and cover, they stay valid when operators change. Renewing on time prevents lapses that close outlets or void cover.
We carry professional liability and errors and omissions cover, and we add you as an additional insured if you ask.

For [pre-opening readiness](/development/), you provide the completed building works, the opening-budget funding and your appointed local team or general manager. We help you obtain all required licences, including occupational, liquor and health department licences.

blocks.heading: Data-Driven Assessment of Your Current Operations
paragraphs: We assess how your property runs today using benchmarking, reporting and technology for upgrading your systems.

steps.heading: Share operating records
steps.text: You give us read-only access to 12 months of P&L statements, PMS reports, payroll and timekeeping records, maintenance and work-order logs, and guest reviews and complaint logs, along with your current vendor contracts.

steps.heading: Rebuild missing baselines
steps.text: If your labour, maintenance or guest-service records are incomplete, the assessment still goes ahead. We rebuild baselines from payroll exports, vendor invoices and online reviews. We mark the less precise findings as estimates that show direction, not exact figures.

steps.heading: Assessment fee
steps.text: You pay a fixed assessment fee. It rises with your room count, your revenue outlets and the number of systems we connect beyond your PMS and channel manager. Rebuilding missing records also raises the fee.

steps.heading: Extra scope
steps.text: Analysing more than 3 years of history costs more, and so does reviewing several properties together. If your hotel has more than 200 rooms, you get a custom quote.

steps.heading: Establish complete tracking
steps.text: We don't hold back the assessment until your records are perfect. Instead, we set up tracking while we diagnose, which gives you 90 days of complete data for the follow-up review.

steps.heading: Identify recovery priorities
steps.text: Our [recovery diagnosis](/receivership/) examines your financial health, market position, physical condition and operating performance. We trace revenue, cost, staffing and brand-compliance problems to their causes. Then we define corrections and repositioning opportunities specific to your property.

blocks.heading: Tailored Improvements, KPIs and Technology That Drives Results

items.heading: Property-specific improvements
paragraphs: We use your operational data to design improvements and new revenue streams for your hotel. We benchmark your costs against comparable properties and keep within your capital spending limit.

items.heading: No-capital changes first
paragraphs: We make labour scheduling changes, procurement savings, rate and channel adjustments, and sales and marketing fixes before any capital projects. That way, the straightforward improvements don't depend on major investment decisions.

items.heading: Capital approval choices
paragraphs: For each capital item, we show you the cost, the timing and the effect on future cash flow, and you decide whether to approve, defer or drop it. If a deferral lets wear or competitive gaps build up, it raises your costs later.

items.heading: Daily revenue measures
paragraphs: Every day, we track your rate, occupancy and RevPAR against your competitive set, along with RevPAR index, ADR, booking pace and channel costs. We report these against your approved budget.

items.heading: Operating performance measures
paragraphs: We also report your GOP margin, departmental cost ratios, labour cost per occupied room, NOI and cash flow against your approved budget.

items.heading: Technology and provider oversight
paragraphs: Our [property-specific IT services](/information-technology/) cover cloud platforms, payment processing, telecommunications, monitoring, managed services, and cyber and privacy compliance. We also oversee your technology partners, hold your providers accountable and negotiate terms with them.

paragraphs: Your dedicated revenue manager sets your room rates every day. They also make your pricing, channel and inventory decisions daily, based on booking pace, pickup, demand, seasonality and your competitive set.

items.heading: Approved price boundaries

hero.heading: Hotel Information Technology Services
lead: A dedicated specialist on our team helps you choose technology that fits how your hotel operates, rather than imposing a standard package.

blocks.heading: Hotel Information Technology, Tailored to the Way You Work
paragraphs: You'll have a dedicated IT representative who gets to know how your hotel runs and helps you choose the technologies that suit it. We don't hand you a standard package. We build your hotel IT solution around what you need.

blocks.heading: Choose Your Route: Project, Selection or Managed IT

items.heading: Choose your route
paragraphs: If your hotel has no in-house IT staff, or runs several connected or custom-integrated systems, ongoing managed IT is the right fit. If you have a capable team or vendor who will take over, a one-off project is the right fit.

items.heading: Agree your plan
paragraphs: You get a written inventory of your systems and vendor contracts. It comes with assessments of how well each one fits your workflows and what it costs, plus recommendations on which systems to keep, connect or replace and in what order. You agree the plan before we build or change anything.

items.heading: Project or monthly service
paragraphs: Our fixed-scope projects cover design, build and testing. After handover, your team and vendors operate and maintain what we delivered. Our monthly managed IT plan includes daily monitoring, and your staff report any issues to us.

items.heading: Connect unsupported systems
paragraphs: If there's no supported connector, we build the links through vendor APIs or scheduled file exchanges. Under managed IT, we monitor, maintain and update those integrations when interfaces change. With a project, your handover includes documentation for your vendor.

items.heading: IT without management
paragraphs: We're MotelPilot, a third-party hotel and revenue management company. You can buy standalone IT projects, system selection or managed IT from us without signing a management agreement.

items.heading: Our company
paragraphs: Our [Canadian company and 25-person team](/about-us/) support independent lodging owners across all types of property, including in the United States, France, Canada and Australia.

items.heading: Remote service delivery
paragraphs: We deliver [every service remotely](/our-process/). Our team runs the work, and none of our staff are stationed at your property.

blocks.heading: Remote Rollout, Testing and Switchover

items.heading: Project timing
paragraphs: Your project takes 6 to 10 weeks from planning to tested handover. We schedule the switchover for a night with low occupancy, keep you offline for no more than 4 hours and put front-desk fallback procedures in place.

items.heading: Local installation support
paragraphs: You appoint one on-site contact and a local contractor for any cabling or hardware installation. We guide them through each installation step remotely by video call and webinar.

items.heading: Progress and sign-off
paragraphs: We plan the rollout around your property and regularly review progress and direction with your key on-site managers. We run the acceptance tests ourselves before you sign off.

items.heading: Reservation testing
paragraphs: Before handover, we create, modify and cancel at least 20 test reservations across your booking engine, channel manager and PMS.

items.heading: Payments and test evidence
paragraphs: We test card payments and refunds in test mode through your PCI DSS-compliant partner. For each test case, your written report records the expected result, the actual result and any open issues. You accept only once every critical case passes.

items.heading: Data migration checks
paragraphs: We export future reservations, guest profiles and rate data from your old system and import them into the new one. Then we reconcile record counts and totals and check at least 50 reservations line by line.

items.heading: Switchover rollback
paragraphs: We keep your old system ready until the reconciliation and acceptance tests pass. After that, it stays available read-only for 30 days. If the cutover fails, we use the tested rollback to restore your original setup within the 4-hour offline window.

items.heading: Managed configuration and faults
paragraphs: After rollout, we make and log configuration changes on your deployed systems. We also diagnose faults remotely and escalate them to vendors. Your on-site team handles physical tasks such as restarting devices.

blocks.heading: Security, Access and Privacy, Covered

items.heading: Managed security controls
items.text: On the hotel devices and accounts covered by managed IT, we maintain multi-factor authentication, role-based permissions and centralised endpoint protection.

items.heading: Vendor security responsibilities
items.text: Security settings inside your PMS, booking engine and other vendor software are each software vendor's responsibility, not ours.

items.heading: Your account approvals
items.text: You approve new user accounts and tell us when staff leave. When you tell us, we remove their access.

items.heading: Our system access
items.text: We use named individual accounts with multi-factor authentication and only the lowest level of access each task needs. We never ask for payment credentials.

items.heading: Access oversight
items.text: We log every session so you can review it, and we check all access rights every 90 days. You can revoke any of our accounts immediately.

items.heading: Privacy and data hosting
items.text: We follow [applicable privacy protections](/privacy-policy/) and use PCI DSS-compliant partners, so card data never enters our systems. We use Canadian cloud hosting, and French properties can ask for EU storage.

blocks.heading: Our Technology Stack and Trusted Partners

items.heading: Partner accountability
paragraphs: We're your single point of accountability for technology partners. We oversee your service providers, manage how your vendors perform and secure the best contract terms on your behalf.

items.heading: Cloud platforms and services
paragraphs: We work with leading cloud and web-based platforms. We also work with preferred hospitality technology partners for credit card processing, telecommunications, monitoring, IT service delivery, managed services, and full cyber and privacy compliance programmes.

items.heading: Hotel management technology
paragraphs: For independent hotels, our hotel management technology brings together our own operating, pricing and reporting tools with assigned specialists, secure collaboration systems, managed connectivity, business applications and high-speed internet support.

items.heading: Commercial technology selection
paragraphs: We [assess and select commercial technology](/commercial-strategy/) for you, install and configure it, and then train your staff on those systems and their marketing applications and programmes.

blocks.heading: Ongoing Support and Updates
paragraphs: Before you sign, you confirm which PCs and network devices your managed plan covers and who handles cloud updates and hardware replacement. We manage your property's firewall and network security. We also apply operating system and security updates to the covered devices during a monthly maintenance window. Cloud software updates come from each software vendor, and this includes your PMS and channel manager. Your on-site staff or local contractor replace physical devices.

rows: PIP timeline
4 to 8 months from appointment to closeout. About 2 to 3 months of that is pre-construction.
Full renovation timeline
9 to 15 months, of which 3 to 5 months is pre-construction.
New-build timeline
18 to 30 months, of which 6 to 12 months is pre-construction.
Pre-construction
These periods include design, permits, pricing and procurement.
Total project budget
Your budget covers hard construction costs; architect, engineer and consultant fees; permits and connections; FF&E, OS&E and IT; pre-opening costs; and construction-period financing.
Contingency
We set aside 10% of hard costs for new builds and 15% for renovations at operating hotels. No draw happens without your prior written approval.
Budget and schedule
We give you both at appointment and track performance against them throughout. When a budget line is forecast to exceed its allowance by more than 5%, we flag it for your approval.
Monthly reporting

You get a written cost report, a dashboard and a monthly owner report. Together they show approved budgets, signed-contract and purchase-order commitments, actual spending, forecast cost to complete and the funding still required. You can also view the dashboard live.
Cost accountability
We track committed, forecast and contingency costs by budget line, programme and property, and we link every cost change to the decision behind it.
Progress reporting
Our reports cover schedule progress, critical-path milestones, open risks and every approved or pending scope change. Between monthly reports, we send you a short weekly progress email.
Closeout documents
You receive PDFs of the as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, guarantees, contractor final releases, final cost reconciliation and the completed punch list.

hero.heading: Hotel Receivership Services to Keep Your Hotel Running
lead: As court-appointed receiver and turnaround manager, we help stabilize your distressed property with experience from more than 75 assignments alongside lenders and servicers.

blocks.heading: Court-Appointed Receivership for Hotels of Every Type
paragraphs: Since 2016, we've completed more than 75 receivership and distressed hotel assignments alongside lenders and special servicers. We step in as court-appointed receiver and turnaround manager across multiple markets for economy, select-service, limited-service and full-service hotels, boutique independents and resorts. Our work also covers branded and independent properties, condo associations and other hospitality receiverships.

blocks.heading: Lenders, Servicers and Owners We Serve

items.heading: Clients we serve
paragraphs: We support banks and financial institutions holding defaulted or foreclosed hotel loans, special servicers, OREO and special-asset departments, and legal counsel. We also support owners who need a turnaround and borrowers whose lenders require outside help.

items.heading: Where we work
paragraphs: We take on receivership and REO hotel assignments in the United States, Canada, France and Australia. Where local law requires a licensed receiver, we work alongside that appointee.

items.heading: Before you file
paragraphs: When you bring us in before the receivership motion, we clear conflicts and help your counsel draft an order that fits how the hotel operates.

items.heading: Defining our authority
paragraphs: We work with your counsel on the proposed receivership order, which sets out our powers, bond, duties and reporting obligations.

items.heading: Checking our relationships
paragraphs: Before we accept an appointment, we check the borrower, its principals and affiliates, the lender and the brand against our client and portfolio records, and we disclose every relationship we find.

items.heading: Confirming our independence
paragraphs: We confirm our independence to the court in writing, by declaration when required. When a conflict can't be cleared, we decline the appointment.

items.heading: Our management team
paragraphs: MotelPilot provides third-party hotel and revenue management through [our 25-person team](/about-us/), which covers hotel operations, revenue management and owner reporting.

blocks.heading: Taking Control of the Hotel in the First 72 Hours

steps.heading: Establish responsibility
steps.text: We take responsibility for everything, from the initial asset inventory and condition review through employees, vendors, franchise relationships, daily operations and the exit strategy.

steps.heading: Deploy local support
steps.text: We don't keep staff at any property. Instead, a local security or property-services agent that we hire is at your hotel within 24 hours of the signed order.

steps.heading: Secure hotel control
steps.text: In that same window, we take control of systems, bank accounts and reporting. Under our direction by video, our agent changes locks and safe combinations, counts and seals cash, and secures the front desk.

steps.heading: Complete immediate checks
steps.text: In the first 72 hours, we confirm payroll, insurance and utilities, contact the brand, key vendors and staff, and send you our first status report.

steps.heading: Confirm on-site leadership
steps.text: If you trust and approve the existing general manager, they stay on as on-site lead. If you don't, we recruit an interim general manager within 7 days, and that person reports to us daily.

steps.heading: Support hotel employees
steps.text: Through our [human resources services](/human-resources/), we help keep the hotel's staff in place and supported through the receivership.

blocks.heading: Securing Systems, Records and Licences

items.heading: Recover withheld access
paragraphs: If the borrower withholds records, systems or cash, we document the refusals for your counsel's turnover application. Meanwhile, we keep the hotel trading through bank, PMS and OTA access that we obtain directly.

items.heading: Rebuild incomplete books
paragraphs: If the records are incomplete, we reconstruct opening balances from bank statements, PMS reports, tax filings and vendor statements. We flag every gap in our first report to you and the court.

items.heading: Take over logins
paragraphs: On day one, we take over the PMS, channel manager, OTA and brand extranet logins so that we control the hotel's operating systems.

items.heading: Continue card payments
paragraphs: We open a merchant account in the receiver's name and switch processing over during a low-occupancy window, so bookings and payments carry on without a break.

items.heading: Begin permit filings
paragraphs: Within 5 business days, we start transferring or reissuing liquor licences and occupancy and operating permits to the receivership estate. A local licensed permit agent handles the in-person filings for us.

items.heading: Maintain licence continuity
paragraphs: Under the court order, the existing licences stay in force until the transfer is complete, so they remain effective throughout the changeover.

blocks.heading: Honouring Contracts, Reservations and Deposits

items.heading: Review existing contracts
paragraphs: Where the order allows, we keep equipment leases and service and supply contracts running. Within 30 days, we review each one and decide whether to keep it, renegotiate it or end it.

items.heading: Replace nontransferable agreements
paragraphs: Some agreements can't transfer or continue, and that includes any prior management agreement. For each of these, we arrange a replacement before it stops. When court approval is required, we get it.

items.heading: Honour existing bookings
paragraphs: Unless the order says otherwise, we honour reservations, group contracts and advance deposits made before our appointment. This keeps things running without a break for guests, employees, vendors and the hotel's existing business.

items.heading: Handle missing deposits
paragraphs: If a deposit never reached the hotel's accounts, we still honour the booking. We record the shortfall as a pre-appointment claim for the court and the lender to deal with.

blocks.heading: Receiver Bond, Separate Accounts and 13-Week Cash Forecasting

items.heading: Post the bond
items.text: Before we take control, we post the receiver bond the court has ordered. Its premium is an approved expense of the receivership estate.

items.heading: Separate hotel accounts
items.text: We open separate operating and payroll accounts in the receiver's name and hold the signing authority the court grants. The lender gets read-only visibility of every account.

items.heading: Keep obligations current
items.text: We manage the hotel's income so that franchise fees, property taxes and vendor accounts stay current and paid.

items.heading: Restrict historical payments
items.text: We pay pre-appointment payables, tax liens and unpaid occupancy taxes out of hotel cash only when a court order or the lender authorises it.

items.heading: Forecast cash requirements
items.text: In our first week, we build a 13-week cash flow forecast and then update it every week.

items.heading: Identify funding gaps
items.text: Our forecast flags payroll, utility and emergency-repair shortfalls at least 2 weeks before they happen.

items.heading: Plan protective advances
items.text: You plan for protective advances from the start. Don't assume hotel receipts will cover every cost.

items.heading: Request lender funding
items.text: When receipts can't cover a cost, we send its amount, purpose and supporting quotes in writing. The lender then funds a protective advance into the receivership account.

blocks.heading: Court and Lender Reporting, Testimony and Fees

items.heading: Initial inventory report
items.text: Within 30 days of our appointment, we report on cash, bank balances, receivables, payables, FF&E, supplies, contracts, licences, permits, the property's condition and any immediate risks.

items.heading: Monthly financial reporting
items.text: You and the court receive our monthly report within 10 business days of each month-end. It includes a USALI P&L, a balance sheet, a cash reconciliation and a budget-to-actual variance.

items.heading: Operating budget approval
items.text: The operating budget takes effect when you give your written approval early on. Once the inventory shows the property's actual condition, we revise it.

items.heading: Named reporting liaison
items.text: Our named liaison gives you asset analysis, revenue and profit forecasts, and updates on significant issues. When required, the liaison gives them to the court as well.

items.heading: Evidence and testimony
items.text: We prepare the declarations, facts and exhibits for applications and testify about hotel operations by video. Your counsel files and argues the applications.

items.heading: In-person court attendance
items.text: When the court requires a witness in the courtroom, our locally licensed appointee attends and uses the evidence we've prepared.

items.heading: Combined service fee
items.text: We charge one flat fee that covers both management and receivership. We submit it with reimbursable expenses in each monthly report for approval by court order.

items.heading: Interim fee payments
items.text: Until approval comes through, we're paid on the interim basis the order permits. If the court reduces an amount, we correct it in the next report.

blocks.heading: Protecting the Brand and Franchise Relationship

items.heading: Early brand contact
paragraphs: We contact the franchisor right away to protect standards and keep the flag. We use our relationships with representatives of major franchises to resolve existing issues quickly, without waiting for default notices.

items.heading: Written relief request
paragraphs: Within 7 days of our appointment, we ask for a hold on cure deadlines and a deferral of PIP requirements. We back the request with a stabilization plan and a schedule for life-safety and brand-standard work.

items.heading: Brand approval limits
paragraphs: We can't guarantee the brand will agree. When it does, we document the revised deadlines in a written forbearance or comfort letter and share it with you and the court.

items.heading: Your brand representative
paragraphs: Through our [asset management](/asset-management/), we represent you remotely on franchise applications, PIPs, standards and fee audits. Our property evaluations and capital planning support the hotel's value and profitability. This is representation, not approved or preferred operator status with any franchisor.

items.heading: Revenue transition support
paragraphs: Our [commercial strategy](/commercial-strategy/) gives you a written, prioritised audit of revenue and systems within 10 business days of getting read-only access. For a de-flag or re-flag, we start rebuilding rates, channel mappings and demand 90 days before the change and track bookings until 60 days after it.

blocks.heading: Related Services and Our Five-Step Approach

items.heading: Revenue management
items.text: Our [revenue management](/revenue-management/) starts with an analysis of your competitive market. We use it to reset strategy, protect existing accounts, rebuild demand and market share, and improve brand positioning, digital presence and guest experience.

items.heading: Operations management
items.text: With our [operations management](/operations-management/), we align staffing, purchasing, vendors and operating expenses so your hotel runs more efficiently.

items.heading: Independent hotel management
items.text: With our [third-party hotel management](/), we run your independent hotel's day-to-day operations remotely, and you keep ownership.

items.heading: Five-step approach
items.text: We organise our receivership work with you around five steps: Assess, Stabilize, Optimize, Report and Transition.

blocks.heading: Life-Safety Repairs and Spending Approval Limits
paragraphs: When the operating account can't cover a life-safety repair, we ask you to approve the funding. We then record the approved advance and report it. Your spending limits keep you in control of capital and over-budget work, and routine operations and emergency safety work still go ahead.

Without your prior approval, we spend only within the receivership budget you've approved and within the limits of the court order. Every capital project needs your written sign-off before it goes ahead, and so does any single item more than 10% over its budget line. The one exception is emergency work needed to keep guests and staff safe. We report that work within 24 hours.

paragraphs: We take on properties of any size. You don't need a minimum room count, revenue or asset value to work with us.

items.heading: Remote operational access
paragraphs: We oversee operations, renovations and your operator remotely, using read access to your PMS and accounting systems, weekly reports from the operator and scheduled video walkthroughs.

items.heading: Independent local inspections
paragraphs: When a property needs an in-person inspection, we hire an independent local inspector or engineer and go through their report with you within 5 business days.

blocks.heading: Our Track Record and Owner References
paragraphs: We've been operating since 2016, and today we provide management or revenue management for 60 hotels and motels. You can read more in our [company background](/about-us/).

Before you sign, we'll arrange calls with up to 3 current owner clients who have agreed to speak with you. blocks.heading: Initial Performance Review

items.heading: Data and timing
paragraphs: The review takes 4 to 6 weeks from kick-off to written recommendations. It starts once we have your last 24 months of P&Ls, your STR or benchmark reports, read-only access to your PMS and your management agreement.

items.heading: Independent diagnostic work
paragraphs: We carry out operational assessments and detailed benchmarking to find opportunities and give you detailed recommendations.

items.heading: Commercial review scope
