items.heading: Operational review scope
paragraphs: We go through departmental expenses, staffing, HR practices, operating processes and guest service to find where performance needs to improve.

items.heading: Quantified action priorities

items.heading: Your implementation plan
paragraphs: Every recommendation comes with a priority, a responsible owner and a timeline. We take your team through it in a 60-minute walkthrough, and you or your operator can then implement the plan on your own.

items.heading: Optional delivery support

items.heading: Operating efficiency improvements

items.heading: Financial and capital controls
items.text: We negotiate annual budgets, prepare P&L and cash flow forecasts, prepare and monitor CapEx budgets, and keep FF&E accounting and spending under control.

items.heading: Clearly attributed results
items.text: Every report compares your results with your competitive set, showing what came from market demand and what came from your hotel outperforming it. We also separate the areas affected by capital work from the rest of the operation, which shows you the gains from a renovation.

items.heading: Forward revenue intelligence
items.text: Our [revenue management](/revenue-management/) reviews 12 months of pace every week and demand every day. It also forecasts the current month and three and six months ahead, reviews intelligence every month and reviews rolling 12-month group rates every quarter.

items.heading: Capital project delivery
items.text: Our turnkey [project management](/project-management/) handles procurement, new builds, conversions, renovations, PIPs, building systems, 5-year budgeted capital, emergency capital, and technical design and construction, keeping disruption to your business to a minimum.

items.heading: Reviewed financial reporting

items.heading: Strategy and operating analysis
paragraphs: We review positioning, strategy, revenue budgets and forecasts, plan capital and investment, and evaluate internal processes and detailed internal data against industry benchmarks.

items.heading: Owner investment advice

items.heading: Limited owner time

items.heading: Monthly operator accountability
paragraphs: Each month you get a report and a review meeting with your operator's operations team, covering revenue against budget and forecast, capital planning and open issues.

items.heading: Budget and valuation reviews

items.heading: Market terms comparison
items.text: We compare your management contract or lease with current market terms and assess how suitable and effective your current operator is.

items.heading: Commercial provision testing
items.text: We test the base and incentive fees, performance clauses, term, termination rights and your obligations as owner, including reserves and funding calls.

items.heading: Owner commercial representation
items.text: We represent you when you renegotiate fees, performance clauses and contract term with your operator.

items.heading: Your counsel's role

items.heading: Operator exit assessment
items.text: If leaving is the better option, we assess your termination rights and exit costs and build your case from the performance-test results.

items.heading: Planned operator transition

items.heading: Standalone project engagement
items.text: You can commission a contract or lease review and renegotiation, or a buy, hold or sell analysis, without a management agreement.

items.heading: Turnaround implementation

items.heading: Support throughout recovery

blocks.heading: Accounting, Payroll and Banking Coverage

items.heading: Daily financial priorities
paragraphs: Every day, precise income auditing, receivables collection and cash balancing come first. We check every line item twice before any figures move forward.

items.heading: Finance function coverage
paragraphs: Our team takes care of treasury, accounts payable, fixed asset accounting, internal audits, guidance on third-party audits and support for your joint ventures.

items.heading: Payroll across roles
paragraphs: We pay your tipped, hourly and salaried employees and distribute service charges. When staff work across departments, we apply the correct rate for each role.

items.heading: Banking and controls
paragraphs: Working in your accounts, our remote team handles reduced-fee ACH, bank checks against approved payment records, electronic bank reconciliation, card and payment processing, bank-account setup and upkeep, insurance purchasing support, financial audits and an annual internal control audit.

blocks.heading: Daily Income Audit and Reconciliation
paragraphs: Every day, we reconcile your PMS night audit against your POS totals, card processor settlements, OTA statements and virtual card payouts. Any amount that doesn't match goes to your manager by the next business day. We record room revenue gross and book OTA commissions separately as a distribution expense. blocks.heading: Tax Filings, Privacy and Payment Compliance
paragraphs: We process and report your lodging, occupancy, sales and use taxes by each local deadline. Your own accountant keeps your corporate income tax returns, statutory financial statement audits and any filings that need their locally licensed signature. We supply the supporting schedules for that work.

Our [privacy and payment safeguards](/privacy-policy/) follow Canada's PIPEDA, France's GDPR, the Australian Privacy Act and relevant US state laws. Card data stays outside our systems because we use PCI DSS-compliant processors. We provide Canadian cloud hosting, and on request we store data for French properties in the EU.

blocks.heading: Working Alongside Your Bookkeeper
paragraphs: Your bookkeeper can keep handling daily deposit entry, petty cash or vendor invoice coding, and we take on the rest, including income auditing, payables, payroll processing and month-end close. paragraphs: If a former manager controls your extranet, we help you file an ownership verification request with Booking.com to get your admin rights back.

blocks.heading: Per-channel OTA listing optimization and loyalty programmes

hero.heading: MotelPilot Privacy Policy
lead: We explain how we handle your personal data and how our responsibilities differ when processing guest information on a property's behalf.

blocks.heading: Who this policy covers
paragraphs: This policy applies to personal data about people who visit our website or get in touch with us, property owners and their representatives, and guests whose data we handle under client agreements. MotelPilot is a Canadian company, and we're responsible for the personal data we collect for our own purposes. Guest data we process on a property's behalf works differently: the property decides how it's used, and we act on its instructions as set out in our agreement.
At least once a year we review this policy, and we update it whenever our practices or legal obligations change.

blocks.heading: The data we collect

items.heading: Information you submit
paragraphs: Whatever you enter in our forms, such as your name, email address, phone number, property details and message.

items.heading: Website visits
paragraphs: Technical and analytics information, including your IP address, browser, device, the pages you visit and the page that referred you to our site.

items.heading: Client and guest records
paragraphs: Under client agreements, we handle owner contact details, booking records, guest contact information, stay details, guest communications and the operational reports needed to deliver the agreed services. Card payments go only through PCI DSS-compliant processing partners, so card data never passes through our own systems.

blocks.heading: How we use, retain and share data

items.heading: Uses and legal grounds
paragraphs: Personal data lets us answer enquiries, deliver the services we've agreed to, keep in touch with you, see how people use our website and protect our systems. Our legal basis depends on the activity and the law that applies. It can be consent, taking steps toward or performing a contract, a legal obligation, or legitimate interests that don't override your rights. For guest data a client controls, we follow that client's documented instructions.

items.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Data stays with us only as long as its purpose, our agreements and applicable legal requirements call for. We regularly go through what we hold and delete or anonymise anything we no longer need. Client records are returned or deleted as the agreement sets out, unless the law says we must keep them.

items.heading: Sharing
paragraphs: Some data has to go to the providers behind our forms, email, analytics and cloud hosting. Where a client agreement calls for it, data also goes to authorised service partners. All of them must have appropriate confidentiality and data protection safeguards in place. We may also disclose data when the law requires it. We never sell personal data.

blocks.heading: Your rights, cookies and data locations

items.heading: Canada
paragraphs: Our handling of personal data follows PIPEDA. Within legal limits, you can ask to see or correct your data, withdraw consent and challenge how we handle it.

items.heading: European Union
paragraphs: For hotels in France, we follow the GDPR. Where it applies, you can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability, object to processing, withdraw consent and complain to a supervisory authority.

items.heading: Australia
paragraphs: The Australian Privacy Act governs how we handle your information. Subject to its requirements, you can ask to access or correct your personal information and raise a privacy complaint.

items.heading: United States
paragraphs: We comply with the privacy laws of the relevant US states. Depending on your state and whether a given law applies, you may be able to access, correct or delete data, get a copy, appeal a decision or opt out of specified uses. You won't be penalised for using any rights that apply to you.

items.heading: Cookies and choices
paragraphs: Essential cookies keep the site working, and optional analytics cookies help us understand visits. Where consent is required, optional cookies stay off until you agree. You can turn them down or withdraw consent in our cookie settings, and you can block or delete cookies in your browser. Keep in mind that blocking essential cookies may affect how the site works.

items.heading: Advance billing and payment
items.text: Monthly fees are invoiced in advance at the start of each month, and payment is due within 15 days by ACH, international wire or credit card. Our prices are in USD, though you can pay in CAD, EUR or AUD at the exchange rate on the invoice date. A full management agreement also carries a one-time onboarding fee, separate from the revenue management setup fee.

items.heading: Included and third-party costs
items.text: Your fee pays for our team's time and our own pricing, reporting and BI tools. Third-party costs are billed to your property at cost, with no mark-up from us. These include your PMS, channel manager, other software subscriptions, OTA commissions, photographers and specialist partners.

items.text: USD prices don't include applicable sales taxes, and we add those only where the law requires it for your property's location. Your bank's transfer charges are yours to pay. Currency-conversion costs for payments in CAD, EUR or AUD are on us.

items.text: Once the three-month initial period is over, you can end your plan with 30 days' written notice, and there's no exit fee. The one-time setup fee can't be refunded after setup work starts, and we don't refund fees already paid for the current month.

items.text: After the three-month initial period, you can also pause, again with 30 days' written notice. Monthly billing then stops for up to three months. You won't pay a pause fee, and if you restart within that time, you won't pay a new setup fee either.

items.heading: Changing plans
items.text: Upgrades take effect on the day you make the change, and the price difference is prorated for the rest of that month. Downgrades start from your next billing cycle.

items.text: Revenue results aren't guaranteed, and we don't offer refunds, because market demand, competitors and other outside factors all affect performance.
